data.title: 白面鸮 · 鸮类图鉴
data.description: 图鉴里的一只鸮正望向镜头。她停在这一页，认真比较图注里的两种叫声。
data.action: 在数据机柜旁一丝不苟地翻看记载猛禽生态习性的鸟类图鉴
data.promptProse: Ptilopsis sits at a polished oak library desk, analytically comparing feather distribution diagrams in an open hardcover ornithology volume. A green banker's lamp casts focused light across her grid-lined notebook, mechanical pencil, and the quiet rows of book stacks.
data.animaCaption: Her finger rests beneath a technical diagram of an owl's wing feather, quietly cross-referencing acoustic dampening structures.
